Description The 1.54inch e-Paper display from Waveshare is a compact E Ink Spectra 6 full-color panel with 240 x 240 resolution and SPI communication. It is designed for low-power color labels, shelf tags, small status screens, education projects and embedded display prototypes where content should remain visible without a backlight. This 1.54inch e-Paper display keeps the last image visible for a long time even after power-off, and power is mainly required during refresh. The reflective paper-like panel has a viewing angle over 170 degrees and works best under ambient light, making it suitable for readable always-on information panels. The queue includes two official variants. Waveshare-35201 is the raw display only for custom integration. Waveshare-35486 includes the driver board, SPI control interface and onboard voltage translator for Raspberry Pi, Jetson Nano, Arduino, STM32 and ESP32 style controller boards. Features E Ink Spectra 6: E6 full-color 1.54inch e-Paper display for compact color graphics. 240 x 240 resolution: square display area for icons, labels, QR-style information and small dashboards. Ultra-low power: no backlight is required, and power is mainly consumed during refresh. SPI interface: supports 3-wire SPI and 4-wire SPI communication. Driver board option: the module version adapts SPI for Raspberry Pi, Jetson Nano, Arduino, STM32 and ESP32. Voltage translator: the driver board version supports 3.3V and 5V controller boards. Paper-like readability: reflective panel with over 170-degree viewing angle for ambient-light applications.
